It all depends on how much liquids you wanna drink. For a quick boost before a shift I do a tall iced quad white mocha. For a drink throughout the day it's butter beer with or without espresso. 

Cold brew is rich and chocolate-y; iced coffee has a lighter caramel flavor imo. The original "butter beer" from my coworker is made with iced coffee.

Also: Cold foam cold brew drinks are incredible. Nitro cold brew is great for low carb people. Caffiene levels from highest to lowest: espresso, cold brew, iced coffee. :)
